text: Reed and Lumen fully bail on searching for Elias, floating off to smell rose petals while Vale gets pulled between three worlds: pressure readings for Flint, soil tests for Dusk's garden, and now weird sticky humidity in the archive room that's making everyone uneasy. Flint stays the lone voice of "just the facts," dismissing chamomile, feelings, and gardens alike, while Dusk keeps insisting the whole point of the new garden plot is to stop measuring and just sit in it. Elias is now officially the town's forgotten problem — nobody's actually looking, they're all just vibing about dew and rose petals instead.
